item: Row 309: a running app re-reads the country form on each new connection and refuses a half-migrated store
key_paths: src/database/country_form.py src/database/session.py src/database/read_snapshot.py src/config/kv_store.py src/backup/country_migration.py src/backup/merge.py src/api/diagnostics/country_form.py tests/test_country_form_recheck_row309.py
summary: An app process alive with an empty pool (after a restore, repair, rebuild, unlock or panic) did not stop the country migration and afterwards wrote with its cached form: measured, de beside FRA under an alpha-3 marker, and after an interrupted run a resume that could never finish. Each new physical connection of the corpus and read-snapshot engines now reads the marker and journal through itself, drops a cached value that differs (the next read goes to the file and fails closed), moves the key's version so an earlier read of it is never cached, and refuses and closes the connection when the journal names an unfinished run, cannot be read or is not a JSON object, for reads as well as writes. A committing restore asks the journal itself, since it merges through raw connections. A wrong passphrase given to migrate is refused by a read-only open first, so it no longer folds a crash-left -wal; a held store is refused, and only a read-only-only failure goes on to the read-write open. A start under a held store says the store is in use and says the app waits up to 30 seconds instead of a damaged journal. Two-process tests on both legs.
